pendentes.titulo: HDMI ou DisplayPort: qual cabo usar no monitor, na TV e no notebook
pendentes.alt: Dois cabos de vídeo enrolados sobre uma bancada de madeira, ao lado da traseira de um monitor apagado com as portas à mostra
pendentes.pedido: Two coiled black video cables with metal connectors resting on a light wooden workbench. Behind them, the back panel of a switched-off computer monitor, seen from a low angle, showing a row of empty rectangular video ports. A small desktop graphics card lies flat at the edge of the bench, slightly out of focus. Soft daylight from a window on the right, shallow depth of field.

pendentes.titulo: iPhone desatualizado: sites invadidos roubavam dados sem nenhum clique
pendentes.alt: Smartphone com a tela apagada, deitado sobre uma mesa de madeira ao lado de um cabo de carregador enrolado
pendentes.pedido: A generic smartphone lying face up on a light wooden desk, its screen completely dark and switched off. A coiled white charging cable rests beside it. Soft morning daylight from a window on the right, shallow depth of field, calm and clean composition, realistic photograph.
